definitions.cohort_root: Every initial living ID is a distinct prospective root; follow post-start parent links until an initial ID is encountered. Existing parent links between initial IDs do not merge roots.
definitions.descendants: Exclude the initial root itself; retain lineage attribution after the root dies.
definitions.at_risk: Initial living individuals, by lineage; report denominators even for tiny lineages.
definitions.diversity: Full 64-byte genome identity (not hash identity); Shannon entropy in nats; Hill effective counts; exact snapshot census.
definitions.interactions: Global deltas from cumulative checkpoint counters are exhaustive. Logged gift/attack/parasite/deposit/build events are only a deterministic 1/256 actor-tick-kind sample; do not extrapolate or infer independent observations.
definitions.causality: Paired deterministic trajectories from one checkpoint are conditional interventions, not independent replications. Additional initial windows test temporal robustness, not independent RNG seeds.
definitions.extinction: The exact ELF stops when population becomes zero. An early-extinct export may have effective_tick < target_tick: population and genealogy are then carried as absorbing zero, while physical state/counters/RNG must remain exactly the extinct checkpoint; no founders or continuing world are created.
definitions.cohort_mean_warning: When all initial IDs died, mean living descendants per initial ID equals final population / initial population by construction. Extant-root fraction, distribution, quantiles and lineage shares carry additional information.
definitions.cache_lineage_normalization: local_cache is cache physically under current occupants of a lineage, not owner-trace property. Per-current-individual divides by current lineage population; cache-share/population-share compares it with the global occupied cache per individual. Extinct lineages have undefined per-individual ratios.
definitions.descendant_quantiles: Nearest-rank census quantiles across all initial roots including zeros; top 1% uses ceil(number of roots / 100).
definitions.population_tick_end: Secondary refinement specified before outcome inspection: reconstruct exact census after every tick from complete births/deaths; keep distinct from predeclared 100-tick series samples and within-tick vacancies.
definitions.uncertainty: No organism-level statistical confidence intervals: shared environment and descent violate independence. Census values are exact for the observed finite trajectories.

owner_trace.meaning: historical builder lineage low32, not enforced cache ownership

population_sample_grid_predeclared.definition: Initial census plus actual regular series samples (tick divisible by config.sample); off-grid endpoint samples excluded. No samples invented after early extinction.

population_tick_end_secondary_refinement.definition: Exact final census at every post-start tick, reconstructed from exhaustive birth/death events; does not measure within-tick vacancies.
